registration_type: prospective verification after exploratory derivation; not preregistration of discovery
scope: fixed homogeneous Lie geometry, geodesic normal/Fermi triad, canonical finite boost, one-time jets; theory and lightweight Wolfram CAS only
candidates: Exact 12-by-9 affine kinematic image with rank 9 and omega - beta cross (A/c)/2 = S w_C
Compact-plus-free-subspace target boundedness iff the target annihilates the free nuisance image
Retained R3 radiation dipole/quadrupole timejet block has rank 8 for all beta squared < 1
A noncommuting finite-tilt correlated disk fixture retains full tensors, signs, shared normalization, and explicit probability assumptions
verification_plan: Independent 4D projection versus affine formula; rank, inverse and normal-limit exact checks
Symbolic Schur complement and determinant of the radiation timejet block; exact beta=(0,3/5,0) witness
Joint disk tensor norms/correlations and declared reference/probability/gain diagnostics
Independent reviewer, separate from all candidate generators, reads frozen report and actual CAS outputs
acceptance: General algebraic proof plus matching exact finite fixtures; physical claims conditional on geometric and radiation-regime assumptions. CAS fixtures alone do not prove generality.
failure_policy: Preserve failed code/output and mark correction. Unresolved signs or missing source hypotheses block the affected claim only. No repeated meta-audit.
excluded: empirical percentage without data likelihood and reference
arbitrary finite-velocity validity of R3 linearized radiation equations
new exact quadrupole or exact Thomson kernel promotion
stop_rule: One bounded derivation, planned lightweight verification, one independent decision review, justified fixes, then save report and reproducibility packet.
